messages:
Alex: Two-sentence one-liner sprint. Drop your best one-liner. Winner gets an invisible trophy :trophy: (I will judge, maybe unfairly)
Margo: I once sneezed and my to-do list crossed itself out. :sneezing_face:
Devin: Parallel parking is just a group project for your car.
Samir: Coffee: because adulting is a trial run. ☕️
Sophie: I put 'do nothing' on my calendar to feel productive. ✅
Olivia: My plants are on a strict PDA schedule: Photosynthesis During Afternoon.
Alex: Nice ones. Quick poll: bagels in the kitchen — plain, sesame, everything, or none? Reply with the emoji:
Alex: :bagel_plain: plain, :seedling: sesame, :boom: everything, :x: none
Margo: :boom:
Devin: :boom: (everything forever)
Samir: :seedling: I like seeds that remind me I'm healthy
Sophie: :bagel_plain: early bird special
lunchbot: Poll recorded: everything (3), sesame (1), plain (1) — results pinned :pushpin:
Alex: Winner: everything. Also: bonus one-liner round — code version:
Samir: ```js
const coffee = 'life';
console.log(`${coffee}();`);
```
Olivia: That code runs in my brain every morning :joy:
Alex: Okay last one: best micro-kudos for this week? quick one-liners only.
Margo: Kudos to @Devin for rescuing the snack drawer. :sparkles:
Devin: thanks! Team snack harmony restored :handshake:
Alex: Alright this thread is a gem. Invisible trophy delivery ETA: soonish. :trophy:
